acceptanceCriteria: Spec defines a device-cleanup contract for device-bound profiles on timeout/interrupt (force-stop bound package, delete Appium session), with failure recorded as incomplete cleanup.
Live witnesses for android-junit, espresso, uiautomator and Appium timeout show no residual device process/session.
body: Found by CEM platform lane V1-0594 (branch claude/cem10-platform-0594 head 11f6802bb, PR beamfall/corvint#1000, corvint build 615) on 2026-10-17. Evidence: /private/tmp/cem10-build/platform-2026-10-17/runs/. Confirmed: after an executor timeout for android-junit, espresso and uiautomator (T cells, recorded A-r), `am instrument` and the app process stayed alive on the emulator; only a manual `am force-stop` ended them (cleanup-check.txt in each Android timeout dir). Appium: the server-side session retired only via newCommandTimeout 60s. TRE-V0-009 timeout+cleanup requires cleanup; the executor has no device-cleanup phase. Release blocker for the Android/Appium timeout cells.
title: Android instrumentation/Appium timeout leaves instrumentation and app processes alive on the device (no device-cleanup phase)
